_doc: Per-job plate resolution and Eevee samples, matched to how large each plate is ever seen (C5 estimate, log 2026-10-17). Full-frame plates render 20% wider than 16:9 for the vertical cut's reframing; cameras fit vertically, so the centre 1920x1080 matches the animatic's framing. First matching rule wins.

rules.why: feed thumbnails, at most ~300 px wide on screen
the feed's live tile: full frame at the start of S50's zoom-out, a texture later; must stay 16:9

c5v._doc: The vertical cut's plates (S35-S56): twice the c5 sizes, so the 9:16 crop of a 3D shot is ~1:1 at 1080x1920 instead of upscaled 1.78x. Feed thumbnails stay small. Render into renders/c5v and cut with assemble.py c5v ... --vertical.

rules.why: feed thumbnails, small in the vertical too
the live tile; S53's feedlive crops it to 9:16
4-up: portrait cells crop a 9:16 slice of each tile
